examples.label: Example 1
examples.input:
5
2 ann@a.io a.lee@b.io
1 bob@a.io
2 a.lee@b.io lee@c.io
1 lee@c.io
1 bob@a.io
examples.display:
contacts = [["ann@a.io", "a.lee@b.io"],
            ["bob@a.io"],
            ["a.lee@b.io", "lee@c.io"],
            ["lee@c.io"],
            ["bob@a.io"]]
output   = [0, 1, 0, 0, 1]

Contacts 0 and 2 share an address, and 2 and 3 share another, so 0, 2 and 3 are one person. Contacts 1 and 4 are another.

examples.label: Example 2
examples.display:
contacts = [["x@m.co"],
            ["y@m.co"]]
output   = [0, 1]

Nothing is shared, so every contact keeps its own number.
